title: Ledger Says Organized Crime Group Spent Millions Targeting Hardware Wallet Users
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Ledger Says Organized Crime Group Spent Millions Targeting Hardware Wallet Users Hardware wallet manufacturer Ledger has released a statement following a “sophisticated” supply chain attack. This post Ledger Says Organized Crime Group Spent Millions Targeting Hardware Wallet Users first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Mathew Di Salvo .
